title: Push payload format undefined: how does ChatMessagePush relate to StateChange
description: RFC 8620 §7.2.2 defines push notifications as carrying a StateChange object. The spec says servers 'include' a ChatMessagePush 'in the push payload' but never defines the relationship. Is ChatMessagePush the entire payload, a field on StateChange, a sibling object? An implementor has nothing to work from. Must define the exact payload structure — likely by looking at how draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush solves this and following the same pattern.
